name: 40515 · Lexington, KY
findings: ZIP 40515 (Lexington) has 105 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 40515 (Lexington) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 40515 (Lexington) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 25.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
